Account Issues.title: Forgot Password
Account Issues.description: The customer cannot remember the password for the account.

verifiedContact.question: Can the customer access their registered email or phone?

resetPassword.solution: Send the customer the password reset instructions and ask them to create a new password.

verifyAccount.solution: Verify the customer's identity using the account recovery process before resetting the password.

Account Issues.title: Account Locked
Account Issues.description: The customer's account has been locked after repeated failed attempts.

lockReason.question: Does the customer know why the account was locked?

unlockAccount.solution: Follow the account unlock process and advise the customer to use the correct credentials.

reviewSecurity.solution: Verify the customer's identity and escalate for a security review before unlocking the account.

Payment Issues.title: Payment Failed
Payment Issues.description: A payment did not complete successfully.

moneyDeducted.question: Was money deducted from the customer's account?

contactedSupport.question: Has the customer already contacted support?

noMoneyDeducted.solution: Ask the customer to retry the payment after checking their payment method and available balance. Escalate to Payment Support if it continues to fail.

transactionCompleted.solution: The transaction was successful. Confirm the transaction details with the customer.

alreadyContacted.solution: Review the customer's existing support request and provide an update.

contactSupport.solution: Ask the customer to contact support so the failed payment can be investigated.

Payment Issues.title: Payment Pending
Payment Issues.description: A payment remains pending and has not completed.

pendingDuration.question: Has the payment been pending for more than 24 hours?

escalatePending.solution: Check the transaction status and escalate the payment to the payment processing team.

waitForPayment.solution: Ask the customer to wait for processing and avoid submitting the payment again.

Payment Issues.title: Money Deducted but Transaction Failed
Payment Issues.description: Money was deducted even though the transaction failed.

refundVisible.question: Is a refund already visible in the customer's account?

confirmRefund.solution: Confirm the refund amount and expected settlement time with the customer.

investigateDeduction.solution: Collect the transaction details and escalate the deducted amount to Payment Support.

Payment Issues.title: Refund Not Received
Payment Issues.description: The customer has not received an expected payment refund.

refundIssued.question: Has the refund been marked as issued?

checkSettlement.solution: Confirm the refund reference and settlement timeframe with the customer.

requestRefundReview.solution: Verify the original transaction and escalate the missing refund for review.

checkConnection.solution: Restart the router and check the connection lights. Escalate if the service remains offline.

powerRouter.solution: Ask the customer to connect the router to power and wait for the connection lights.

Internet Issues.title: Slow Internet
Internet Issues.description: The customer's internet connection is slower than expected.

multipleDevices.question: Are several devices experiencing slow speeds?

checkNetwork.solution: Run a connection check and escalate the network issue if the speed remains below the plan rate.

checkDevice.solution: Restart the affected device and check for downloads or applications using the connection.

Internet Issues.title: Wi-Fi Not Connecting
Internet Issues.description: The customer's device cannot join the Wi-Fi network.

correctPassword.question: Is the customer using the correct Wi-Fi password?

restartWifi.solution: Forget the network, restart Wi-Fi, and reconnect the device.

providePassword.solution: Provide or reset the correct Wi-Fi password and reconnect the device.

Delivery Issues.title: Delivery Delayed
Delivery Issues.description: An order has not arrived by its expected delivery date.

trackingUpdated.question: Has the tracking information updated recently?

shareTracking.solution: Share the latest tracking update and expected delivery date with the customer.

escalateDelivery.solution: Verify the delivery address and escalate the delayed shipment to the delivery team.

Delivery Issues.title: Wrong Item Delivered
Delivery Issues.description: The customer received an item different from what was ordered.

itemUnused.question: Is the incorrect item unused and in its original condition?

arrangeReturn.solution: Arrange a return and replacement for the correct item.

reviewReturn.solution: Review the return options with the customer and escalate if the item cannot be returned.

Delivery Issues.title: Item Not Received
Delivery Issues.description: The order is marked delivered but the customer did not receive it.

deliveryMarked.question: Is the order marked as delivered?

checkDeliveryLocation.solution: Ask the customer to check the delivery location and contact the carrier for delivery details.

traceShipment.solution: Check the latest tracking update and escalate the missing shipment to the delivery team.

Technical Support.title: Device Not Working
Technical Support.description: The customer's supported device is not functioning correctly.

restartDevice.solution: Restart the device and install any available updates. Escalate if the issue continues.

checkPower.solution: Check the power source and cable. Escalate for repair if the device still will not turn on.

Technical Support.title: Application Error
Technical Support.description: The customer sees an error while using the application.

errorRepeats.question: Does the error appear again after restarting the application?

captureError.solution: Record the error message and application version, then escalate to Technical Support.

confirmResolved.solution: Confirm that the application is working normally after the restart.

Technical Support.title: Service Unavailable
Technical Support.description: The customer cannot access a required service.

serviceStatus.question: Is there a known service outage?

shareOutage.solution: Inform the customer about the outage and provide the current restoration estimate.

checkAccount.solution: Check the customer's account and connection details, then escalate if the service remains unavailable.
